analyst_view.overall: Early view: Granada have won five in a row under Pacheta and have a game in hand, after their match with Tenerife was postponed following Jesús de Miguel's death. Ceuta are bottom with 5 points, have lost five straight and have taken one point from six away games, conceding 18. The main question is how many Granada score.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. Granada's winning run has been built on tight scores (1-0, 2-0, 2-1, 2-0), but Ceuta concede three a game away from home, so the two balance out near the site's number, with Granada doing most of the scoring.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners. I lean higher: Córdoba won 11 corners against Ceuta last week, and Granada at home against the bottom side should spend long spells in Ceuta's half; their set pieces are a weapon too, as Rubén Alcaraz's header at Eldense showed.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.7 cards. I lean slightly lower: Ceuta took only two yellows in their 3-0 defeat at Córdoba, and one-sided games where the favourite controls the ball tend to produce fewer bookings.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.3 shots. Ceuta are not passive (12 shots at Córdoba) but give a lot away, so a total in the high 20s fits.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. I lean slightly higher: Córdoba-Ceuta had 12 shots on target, and Ceuta's defence (30 conceded, 18 of them in six away games) lets opponents get clean shots away.
